actions: flexes elbow (prime mover, active regardless of forearm pronation/supination position, unlike biceps)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: musculocutaneous n. main trunk (+ minor radial n. sensory-motor overlap described in some cadaver studies)
functional_compartments.function_note: Largest cross-sectional area of the elbow flexors; deep to biceps.
